name: Orbital Defence
description: Tower defence: 3 maps, 4 towers with branching upgrades, armoured/flying/splitting enemies, targeting modes and abilities.

name: Patient Zero
description: Evolve a pathogen and infect the world before humanity finds a cure. Plague Inc-style strategy.

name: Magic Sort
description: Potion-sorting puzzle: pour colours until every flask is one shade. Endless levels, hints, undo and fog levels.

name: Hardline
description: First-person wave shooter: 6 weapons, armoury between waves, touch or keyboard + mouse. Best in landscape.

name: Smash Dillan PC
description: First-person stealth: sneak round the house, dodge Dillan, find his PC and hammer it to bits.

name: Prank Dillan
description: Neighbours-from-Hell-style prank game: rig traps round a cutaway house and film Dillan's chaos for the TV audience. 4 episodes, 13 pranks.
